start: Watch app may post notifications; a workout open on the phone

steps.action: Log a set on the phone so a rest starts
user_sees: One "Rest" countdown card on the watch, the watch app's own, with Done / +15 s / Skip
must_not: The phone's rest card copied to the watch as well
A buzz at every rest start

steps.action: Let the rest end
user_sees: One buzz from the watch
must_not: Two buzzes (the watch's own and the phone's copied "Rest is over")

tests.checks: s1 see / s1 not: with notifications allowed the phone's rest card and Rest is over are both kept off the watch; s2 not: Rest is over is never copied
s2 see (source text): the rest-end buzz is the watch's own and not under any condition. Not checked: no buzz at rest start, the card's buttons

start: The watch app's notifications are refused in the watch's Settings

steps.action: Start a rest on the phone
user_sees: The phone's own rest countdown card copied to the watch
must_not: No countdown anywhere on the watch

steps.action: Let the rest end
user_sees: One buzz from the watch app (it needs no notification permission)
No "Rest is over" card on the watch
must_not: No buzz
The phone's "Rest is over" copied as a second buzz

tests.checks: s1 see / s1 not: notifications refused lets the phone's countdown card through; s2 not: Rest is over still never copied
s2 see / s2 not: the buzz never waits on the notification permission; the watch has VIBRATE. Not checked: no Rest is over card

start: Pixel Watch; the phone's screen is on in the member's hand at the rest's end

steps.action: Let the rest end
user_sees: The watch's own buzz still comes
must_not: Nothing felt because the copied phone alert is muted while the phone is in use

tests.checks: s1 not (in part): the phone's copied Rest is over is never relied on
s1 see (source text): the watch buzzes itself at rest end. The real mute while the phone is in use needs a real watch

start: Notifications for the watch app were refused, then allowed again

steps.action: Allow the watch app's notifications, then start the next rest
user_sees: Only the watch app's own countdown card (the phone's copy stops)
must_not: Two countdown cards
The phone's copy still coming after the next phone item

tests.checks: s1 see / s1 not (rule only): allowed again means both tags are kept off. Not checked: the settings applied again on the next phone item
s1 see / s1 not (rule only): allowed again means both tags are kept off. Not checked: the settings applied again on the next phone item

start: The watch app may post notifications; a phone item arrives

steps.action: The phone's item wakes the watch app
user_sees: The copy settings set once to leave out the phone's "Rest is over" and rest card
must_not: The settings set again on every item when nothing changed

start: The watch system refuses the copy settings

steps.action: The setting call fails
user_sees: A log line; the settings are tried again on the next phone item
must_not: The failed settings stored as applied, so they are never tried again

start: The watch app was updated from an older version that used the older settings name

steps.action: The app starts after the update
user_sees: The new copy settings applied once
must_not: The old settings kept because the stored name matched

start: Watch app may post notifications; a workout open on the phone; set-up: old saved data in the new version

steps.action: With saved data saved by the old version, update the app, then do "One buzz, not two".
user_sees: The old saved data shown in full, with the same values as before the update
must_not: Old saved data missing, shown with empty or wrong fields, or changed without the user doing anything

steps.action: Let the rest end
user_sees: One buzz from the watch
must_not: Two buzzes (the watch's own and the phone's copied "Rest is over")

note: the older settings name must be replaced once

start: Watch app may post notifications; a workout open on the phone

steps.action: Log a set on the phone so a rest starts
user_sees: One "Rest" countdown card on the watch, the watch app's own, with Done / +15 s / Skip
must_not: The phone's rest card copied to the watch as well
A buzz at every rest start

steps.action: Do step 1 of "One buzz, not two" on the phone with the watch connected; look at both. Then do it from the watch.
user_sees: Phone and watch show the same saved data within a few seconds
must_not: Two different values on phone and watch, a double saved data made by both, or the watch stuck on the old state

note: phone and watch alerts for the same rest

steps.action: Turn the internet off at step 2 of "One buzz, not two", carry on, then turn it back on.
user_sees: A plain word that the work is saved on the device or could not be saved, and it is sent once when the internet is back

start: Watch app may post notifications; a workout open on the phone; set-up: alerts

steps.action: Turn the alert setting that belongs to "One buzz, not two" off, do the journey, then turn it on and do it again.
user_sees: No alert while off; one alert while on
must_not: An alert sent while off, no alert while on, or the saved data itself not saved because alerts are off
